items.title: Mirza mughal
items.description: Mirza Mughal (1817 – 1857) was an Imperial Prince of the Royal Family of India; the fifth son of Emperor Bahadur Shah Zafar, the 12th and last Mughal emperor. His mother, Sharif - ul - Mahal Sayyidini, came from an Aristocratic Sayyid family that claimed descent from Prophet Muhammad.
